scope: Proposition 3.1 (Uniform comparison away from pins) of the manuscript “The first lattice correction to Bloch's law” (preprints/The-first-lattice-correction-to-Blochs-law-October-5-2026/first-lattice-correction-bloch-law.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 271 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4c19762cfd46fbb0), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 6. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every fixed positive half-integer S there are β0(S) < ∞ and a function εS(β) → 0 as β → ∞ such that the following holds for every β ≥ β0(S). Let Λ be any finite cube, let E = D0 ∪ F with F any finite deterministic set of slot-time pins, and let i = (x, a) be a time-zero post-seam slot. Suppose that B50R∗ (x) is interior to Λ and that E has no point above this ball. Then |dE(i) − 1 ℓ nsw S (β)| ≤ εS(β)β−5/2 . (3.1) The same uniform error bound, after enlarging εS if necessary, holds for |EE∪{i}qi − ℓ−1nsw S (β)|.
